'''Deucalon Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], located near the [[Promenade]]. It was used primarily by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-allied individuals to dock their ships.
